note: Maps spec rows (spec/target-spec.md, T-01..T-30) to committed records. A row with no entry reads not-yet-measured. Every (record, row) pair signoff/block-manifest.json cites under evidence."5.analog" and evidence."6.analog" must be graded here by an entry citing a file in that same record directory; the generator fails when one is missing, so the manifest is the list of which rows have a record and this file is how each is graded. A row may carry extra entries the manifest does not cite. Grade a row from every record cited for it: one failing record fails the row. Prefer the record's own per-row digest (rows.json, yield.json) over the raw klt sim envelope when the record has one. An entry graded only on a `fail` count passes a row the record merely `reported` (no limits), so grade the record's own `verdict` alongside it. Never edit a spec target to make a row pass. Fields: record (repo path), field (dotted path; [name=X] picks a list item by its name), op (>= <= ==), value or value_field (sibling field of the same record), corner, scope (CH, TC, BOTH or n/a), basis (what the number is), note.

T-15.note: T-15 FAILS the 7-sigma gate as recorded: mean 31.9 ps, sigma 11.4 ps, sigma-to-spec 2.47 against 7, worst draw 62.6 ps against the +60 ps limit (0.4 % of draws outside).
